"Knife Edge: Chasing Michelin Stars" is a documentary series on Apple TV that tells the story of chasing the highest honour in the culinary world, and it's back now. Here are the details.

"Knife Edge: Chasing Michelin Stars" makes a strong return

Less than a year after the premiere of the first season of "Knife Edge: Chasing Michelin Stars," the show returns with a brand-new eight episodes, continuing to tell the story of restaurants around the world fighting for, maintaining, or adding Michelin stars.

Hosted by food and travel expert Jesse Burgess, with Gordon Ramsay and Studio Ramsay Global serving as executive producers, the series documents the relentless efforts of restaurants, chefs and their teams in their pursuit and defence of the highest honour in the culinary world.

Apple announced a few days ago that the new season will visit a total of 16 restaurants across Europe, the United States and Brazil, each at a different stage of their quest for stars.

Following the premiere of the first two episodes today, new episodes will be released every Friday until 6 November.
